column1: # The checks of shell/nested-password.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# The Shell build reads the HiiDB whose VarStores sit in the scopes of FormSet-level conditions:
# the questions over the password of NestedPassword, under a SUPPRESS_IF, in its form set and
# in one that declares it directly, show no byte of it and set refuses them, while the
# CHECKBOXes on NestedPassword and NestedChoice, the VarStore of id 2 under the DISABLE_IF whose
# condition is FALSE, read and write

column3: .responses | length == 1 and .[0].selector == "8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001C00" and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("<ValueUnavailable: its bytes hold a password>"))
.responses | length == 1 and .[0].selector == "8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001C00" and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("<ValueUnavailable: its bytes hold a password>"))

any(.[]; .name == "Nested setting beside the password" and .answer == "1") and any(.[]; .name == "Nested choice" and .answer == "0") and any(.[]; .name == "Nested password prefix as a number" and (.answer | startswith("<ValueUnavailable: its bytes hold a password>"))) and any(.[]; .name == "Nested password prefix from another form set" and (.answer | startswith("<ValueUnavailable: its bytes hold a password>")))

column1: # set never writes a byte of the password

column3: . == {"error_message": "cannot set question \"Nested password prefix as a number\": EFI variable NestedPassword-8c78a505-baa0-4c4a-869f-000000001c01 holds a password at bytes 0..16, which set never writes"}
